title: Shinonome Akito — The World In My Eyes〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Morning
New York - Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's end things here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
We sang a ton again today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You really sang your heart out today, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's because of all the other people singing near us. I wasn't about to let them steal our shine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, it was pretty nice of Taiga to show us this place. It's good to have somewhere we can practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Practicing in SEKAI is fine and all, but we did all seem to want to sing while immersing ourselves in this atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, before we forget...
What should we do about breakfast?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I guess we didn't really decide anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since we're here, we should eat at one of the places in the neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The bagels they had at the cafe we went to yesterday were really good. They were so crispy, and they came with so much salmon and cream cheese.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's apparently very normal to have that for breakfast in New York. I'm sure there are many shops proudly serving them that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The eggs Benedict we had the day before are standard for breakfast too, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that was really good too!
The English muffin was so fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They both felt like really fancy and special breakfasts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! Speaking of which, do you think there are any famous shops in this neighborhood?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Famous?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we didn't do much research before coming here. We've basically just been working off of Uncle Taiga's recommendations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, that's true, huh.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since we have the chance, why don't we take this opportunity to look for a place to eat on our own?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All the places we've been to so far have been really good, so I can't imagine what a famous one is going to be like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, I think there's a famous bagel shop nearby.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure I heard it ranks among New York's best bagel shops. The cream cheese there is supposed to be unbelievable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They should be open now. Also, by the look of the pictures I saw, it seemed like a nice place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That does sound appetizing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, do you happen to know about any other good places to eat around here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Other good places...?
This one place's eggs Benedict had good reviews.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's their most famous dish, but their French toast is also supposed to be incredible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The reviews on every website I looked at were all good, so it might be worth visiting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There were also some good cafes.
Around here it'd be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, what's with the staring?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I think we're all just really impressed by your knowledge of the cafes around here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Lemme guess... You spent a lot of time researching them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, no really...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even before we came over to the United States, you mentioned wanting to try the pancakes New York had to offer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised that you've done quite a bit of research.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, you don't get many opportunities like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we try going to the places Shinonome recommends today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. Anywhere that Akito recommends is sure to be good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looking forward to all those yummy pancakes, boss.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it.
